title: Notion query or list call returns exactly 100 results and the rest are missing
symptoms: results.length is 100 and has_more is true
Block children list stops at 100 blocks on long pages
Export script misses rows past the first page
cause: List and query endpoints return at most 100 items per call and expect next_cursor to be passed back as start_cursor. Code that reads one response only ever sees the first page.
fix: Loop on has_more and next_cursor, or use the SDK pagination helpers.
apply:
import { collectPaginatedAPI } from "@notionhq/client";
const blocks = await collectPaginatedAPI(notion.blocks.children.list, { block_id: pageId });
affected: Notion REST API, all list and query endpoints, as of 2026-10
